name: Pole bean

schedule.notes: Plant at the base of poles, teepees, or trellises 6 ft+ tall.
Every 2 days at peak. Beans never stop until frost — much longer harvest than bush types.

harvest.cues: Pods firm and snap cleanly. Daily picking keeps plants producing.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge 5 to 7 days. Blanch and freeze.

varieties.name: Kentucky Wonder
varieties.notes: Heirloom standard. 6 to 9 in pods, prolific.

varieties.name: Scarlet Runner
varieties.notes: Stunning red flowers. Hummingbird magnet; beans get fibrous if not picked young.

varieties.name: Rattlesnake
varieties.notes: Heat-tolerant. Purple-streaked pods (streaks fade with cooking).

notes: Set the trellis first; bean roots are shallow and you'll damage them later. Pole beans outyield bush in most seasons and harvest twice as long.
